inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Pathway map: methionine ↔ homocysteine (methionine synthase, B12), methyl-THF transfer, thymidylate synthase (dUMP→dTMP), methylmalonyl-CoA → succinyl-CoA (mutase, B12) — marking the folate trap and B12-specific branches

notes: The B12/folate one-carbon transfer figure (pdf 89 / book 67) is an original KYP redraw preserving the source's full node set (Protein, Methionine, SAM, SAH, Homocysteine, THF, THF–CH3, Adenosine, Cysteine, Heme, TCA cycle, Methylmalonyl-CoA, Succinyl-CoA) with both B12 enzymes and both B6 steps.
